title: CRM Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and customer\-focused Client Relationship Manager (CRM) to manage and strengthen relationships with existing clients. The CRM will be responsible for regular client communication, handling queries and complaints, providing effective after\-sales support, following up on orders and payments, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Maintain regular communication with existing clients and build strong, long\-term relationships.

· Follow up rigorously with clients to ensure all requirements and commitments after order placement are properly addressed.

· Provide continuous after\-sales service and ensure existing clients remain satisfied.

· Maintain regular follow\-ups from the time an order is received until the collection of payment.

· Understand client requirements, queries, concerns, and circumstances and provide appropriate solutions.

· Respond promptly to client calls, questions, and service\-related requests.

· Act as the primary point of contact for client complaints and coordinate with the concerned internal team for resolution.

· Escalate issues to the appropriate department or concerned person whenever required.

· Provide clients with the necessary information and support regarding company products and services.

· Proactively collect genuine feedback from clients regarding products, services, and overall experience.

· Maintain a professional and polite approach in all interactions with clients and colleagues.

· Ensure timely and rigorous follow\-up on pending client requirements, commitments, and issues.

· Support client retention by maintaining strong relationships and addressing concerns effectively.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

· Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to communicate confidently and professionally through both speaking and writing.

· Strong Follow\-Up Skills: Ability to consistently follow up on client requirements, orders, service issues, and payments.

· Customer\-Focused Approach: Ability to understand client circumstances and respond appropriately.

· Proactive Attitude: Takes initiative to identify and resolve client concerns before they become major issues.

· Product/Service Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the company’s products and services.

· Computer Skills: Good working knowledge of computers and basic business applications.

· Problem\-Solving Ability: Ability to understand client queries and coordinate with the relevant team to provide solutions.

· Availability: Should be responsive and available for client calls and important communication as required.

· Professional Disposition: Polite, patient, confident, and professional while dealing with clients.

**Key Performance Areas (KPIs)**

1\. Client satisfaction and relationship management.

2\. Timely follow\-up on client requirements.

3\. Resolution of client queries and complaints.

4\. Quality and responsiveness of after\-sales service.

5\. Client retention and continued engagement.

6\. Timely follow\-up from order placement through payment collection.

7\. Collection and documentation of genuine client feedback.

8\. Effective coordination with internal teams for client\-related issues.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
